mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month acceleration in personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) above the prior 6-month average signals stronger household demand, which boosts corporate earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the subsequent 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of triggered episodes, or Rank IC drops below 0.05 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in the unemployment rate above 4.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing corporate margin expectations and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes, or Rank IC remains below 0.04 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below the prior 6-month average signals weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces earnings growth expectations and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the subsequent 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered episodes, or Rank IC drops below 0.05 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a restrictive monetary stance, raising discount rates and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes, or Rank IC remains below 0.04 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in housing starts (HOUST) below the prior 6-month average signals weakening residential demand, which reduces construction sector earnings and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the subsequent 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered episodes, or Rank IC drops below 0.05 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in payroll employment (PAYEMS) above the prior 6-month average signals labor market strength, which boosts consumer spending and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of triggered episodes, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month acceleration in personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) above the prior 6-month average combined with a 3-month decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below the prior 6-month average signals a demand-driven growth regime with supply constraints, which boosts earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 3-month change > 0.5% AND INDPRO 3-month change < -0.5% after 6-month averages
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of triggered episodes, or Rank IC drops below 0.04 over any 2-year window.
